verdict.rationale: Box documents a full REST API (base URL, OAuth token auth, curl example) with dedicated guides for chunked uploads, shared links, collaborations, search, metadata, webhooks, and events — covering upload/download/list/move/delete-style file operations over documented endpoints, not just a desktop client. Community evidence critiques the desktop client's sync/UX but does not contradict the REST API's existence or functionality. Missing for 10: no independent hands-on developer report confirming CRUD operations work smoothly, and no discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec (404s on probe).
